  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      Result(double slope, double intercept, double zeroCrossingFlow, double operatingFlow, double predictedThrust, double marginFraction, boolean nearNullThrust, double marginThresholdFraction, String thrustDirection)
      Create a result.
      Parameters:
      slope - slope of the fitted thrust-vs-flow trend
      intercept - intercept of the fitted trend
      zeroCrossingFlow - flow at which the trend crosses zero thrust
      operatingFlow - the flow that was screened
      predictedThrust - trend-predicted thrust load at operatingFlow
      marginFraction - signed distance of operatingFlow from the crossing flow, as a fraction of the crossing flow
      nearNullThrust - true if |marginFraction| is below the configured threshold
      marginThresholdFraction - the threshold fraction used for the flag
      thrustDirection - "INBOARD", "OUTBOARD" or "NULL" for the predicted thrust sign at operatingFlow
